evidence.excerpt: Đukić has completed two industry-contract root-cause investigation engagements for regional fermentation manufacturers (one antibiotic producer, one enzyme producer) over the past eight years. He has also served as an external technical reviewer for a new product registration dossier at a Serbian pharmaceutical fermentation facility.
